answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault: creating identities is cheap, but each one must post collateral that is slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior. Honest agents pass a jade-green attestation check, where independent peers verify distinct work histories and unique resource usage, so one operator cannot cheaply spin up a spiral of clones. The stake makes each extra identity cost real capital, and slashing makes coordinated fakery unprofitable.
